column3: Close to the Hebrew; לְעִיִּים (“into ruins”) is rendered “in heaps.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your godly ones” is rendered “Your saints.”
Close to the Hebrew; the singular “it has devoured” is rendered as plural, “they have devoured.”
Close to the Hebrew; “atone for our sins” is rendered “provide atonement for our sins.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your arm” is rendered “Your power,” and “leave over the sons of death” “Preserve those who are appointed to die.”
